reusable_patterns.pattern_name: Invariant C2 HTTP Beaconing / Command Endpoint Pattern
reusable_patterns.stable_characteristics: Repeated outbound HTTP transactions targeting deterministic API paths with constant header presence across sessions.
reusable_patterns.generalization_rationale: Matches protocol communication mechanics independent of source/destination IP addresses or domain infrastructure.

reusable_patterns.pattern_name: Exploitation Payload Token in Request Headers / URI
reusable_patterns.stable_characteristics: Presence of shell metacharacters, JNDI lookup strings, or anomalous SQL syntax inside client request headers.
reusable_patterns.generalization_rationale: Focuses on the vulnerability exploitation vector itself, protecting against polymorphic attack delivery across multiple hosts.
